prose: Chinese state media report that DeepSeek and MiniMax have completed registration and won approval to open-source and deploy AI models overseas under China's proposed export controls - part of a wave of homegrown AI technologies Beijing is clearing for global release, per Bloomberg.
highlights: DeepSeek and MiniMax approved to open-source and deploy models overseas (Bloomberg via Chinese state media)
Approvals come under China's proposed AI export-control regime
Part of a broader wave of Chinese AI technologies cleared for global deployment
